evidence: Ter. Heaut. 1.1.23: tantumne ab rē tuāst ōtī tibi? (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Free time, the opposite of negōtium, business.

phrases.english: How do you spend your leisure time on weekdays?

sources: Lewis & Short: otium
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
